# device42_auto_discovery_pingsweep (Resource)


## Exemple

```hcl
resource "device42_auto_discovery_pingsweep" "myPingSweepJob" {
   name               = "myPingSweepJob"
   networks           = "192.168.0.0/24"
   create_new_subnet  = "yes"
   schedule_days      = "0,1,2,3,4,5,6"
}
```



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the pingsweep autodiscovery job. Create only (the API upserts by name).
- `networks` (String) Comma separated list of networks to sweep.

### Optional

- `create_new_subnet` (String) Whether to create a new subnet for the discovered addresses. Computed.
- `debug_level` (String) Debug level of the job. Computed.
- `overwrite_subnet_categories` (String) Whether to overwrite the subnet categories. Computed.
- `reverse_dns` (String) Whether to perform a reverse DNS lookup on discovered addresses. Computed.
- `schedule_days` (String) Comma separated days of week (Monday = 0).
- `schedule_time` (String) Time in HH:MM format to schedule the job.
- `strip_domain_suffix` (String) Whether to strip the domain suffix from discovered hostnames. Computed.
- `subnet_category` (String) Subnet category to assign to discovered subnets.
- `type` (String) Type of the pingsweep job.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
